_comment: ONE menu control layout for every cabinet (standup, sit-down, racing rig, flight rig, pedestal). tools/Set-MenuControls.ps1 writes it into each frontend's controls.conf; tools/lib/AmMenuButtons.ps1 names the buttons per controller (Tools > Menu Buttons). joy: by NUMBER, the order the Xbox pad and the CoinOPS wiring table share (0 = A / panel button 1, 1 = B / button 2, 2 = X / button 3, 3 = Y / button 4, 4 = LB / button 5, 5 = RB / button 6, 6 = Back / Select, 7 = Start, 8 / 9 = stick clicks). The G29 numbers its buttons its own way (0 Cross, 1 Square, 2 Circle, 3 Triangle, 4 / 5 right / left paddle, 6 R2, 7 L2, 8 Share, 9 Options, 10 R3, 11 L3), so a wheel keeps the layout its original build had. keys: safe on every cabinet - arrows, Enter / Esc, and the I-PAC default PLAYER 1 keys (buttons Left Ctrl, Left Alt, Space, Left Shift, Z, X, C, V; Start 1; Coin 5). letters: keyboard shortcuts added ONLY on cabinets without a control panel, because a keyboard-wired panel (I-PAC) sends letters for player 2 (stick R F D G, buttons A S Q W ...): R or Q on a panel cabinet would make player 2 jump to a random game or close the frontend. joyNoPedals: added only without pedals (a pedal axis can rest at the end of its travel). Tokens a cabinet has on top (pedal axes, touch gestures, mouse, its own keys) are kept.

nextPlaylist.does: Next filter in a game list (the <- -> bar); shares Right with right, NOT the steering axis

prevPlaylist.does: Previous filter in a game list; shares Left with left, NOT the steering axis

quit.does: Close the frontend (keyboard only, so players can't leave the cabinet)
